description.content:
Documentation on listing Groups via SCIM. 

**OAuth Scope required:** `scim.groups.readGroups`

query.description: The starting index for retrieving this resource. Resources are indexed based on when they were first added to Ironclad.
Specifies the maximum number of resources to return in a single page of results.

Filters for identifying subsets of groups. Filters must comply with the SCIM protocol's convention. For more details, see SCIM [RFC 7644 Section 3.4.2.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.4.2.2).
A comma-separated list of attributes to exclude from the resources in the response.
